context.p: The ADI OtoSense™ SMS REST APIs enable secure communication between the SMS device, the connected web server, and the web and mobile applications. The APIs interact with the ADI OtoSense™ server and manage motor performance data. They deliver actionable insights to field engineers on the dashboard.
